answer: Latency-entropy audits: every epoch, each identity answers small puzzles published mid-epoch, and the network compares response-time fingerprints across accounts. Identities sharing one driver process show correlated latencies and interleaved timing, like stones breaking the same tide, and any cluster flagged at even one vertex of similarity gets its bonds slashed. To spoof independence, an attacker must run separate hardware and separate network routes for every fake identity, so per-identity cost climbs toward its zenith and the sybil multiplier collapses toward one.
